# Notice

This project is a modern Fortran translation of the computational core of the
R package `maxLik`, version 1.5-2.2.

Upstream authors and contributors are listed in `original/maxLik-master/DESCRIPTION`.
The original package is licensed under GPL (>= 2). This translation is licensed
under GPL-2.0-or-later.

The translation is not an official release of, and is not endorsed by, the
upstream maxLik authors. R object systems, printing, plotting, vignette build
machinery, and package integration methods are not translated.
